gold: Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum

selector.rationale: Evidence of an intramuscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle on MRI and a poorly defined collection in the left paraspinal musculature on CT supports Paraspinal abscess as the most specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Pyogenic infection
rejected.why: Too broad, as it does not specify the location or type of infection

rejected.label: Cervical lymphadenitis
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for lymph node involvement

rejected.label: Fusobacterium necrophorum infection
rejected.why: While the microbiological culture indicates F necrophorum infection, it is more specifically related to Lemierre's syndrome, but the primary diagnosis is the abscess itself
